post.text: BREAKING: A new poll found that 74% of Americans suspect Jared Kushner has "likely committed treason" by sabotaging the Iranian peace negotiations and acting as an agent of Israel to force the US into this war.
post.author_description: Dadaist graffiti news. Halfway true comedy and satire for your doomscrolling by @DashMacIntyre. I don't report the facts, I improve them.
